args.name: moss-prepared-root-placement
args.function: Provide a learnable, bounded root-placement trial personally applicable to Moss's cleared prepared surface surface-38-moss-234. Examine current clearance and substrate compatibility before allowing placement of one owned fresh root; report specific incompatibility if placement is not supported.
args.conditions: Tick-70 paid diagnostic found no observed obstruction, zero source cover and residue, and 0.04 conserved litter mass in the separate deposit. Ordinary placement remains ineligible; existing prepared-surface-root-placement is bound to Lin and another surface. Require actual reach, current unoccupied geometry, personal learning and suitable real input. Do not bypass these checks.
args.inputs: At most one owned fresh root for placement; none currently owned. Examination should not consume a root. No use of the nonharvestable litter as input.
args.costs: Method and costs are unknown; specify finite learning and execution costs, reservation rules, interruption and cancellation behavior before use.
args.effects: A dated compatibility finding and, only after learning and valid paid execution with actual material, one bounded root placement. No promised viability, propagation, food yield or wellbeing benefit; no automatic execution or permission grant.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"moss\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Related capabilities have been searched and their available definitions compared. prepared-surface-root-placement@1 supplies the requested examination and paid placement mechanism, but its explicit Lin/surface-21-lin-113/item-3-lin-12 binding excludes Moss and surface-38-moss-234. moss-prepared-surface-diagnostic@1 examines this surface but cannot place a root; root-planting-trial@1 does not admit this prepared surface through its ordinary-soil entry point. Develop only the scoped applicability adapter, recording reuse of the existing mechanisms rather than claiming their reinvention. The tick-70 clearance finding is dated evidence, not current substrate certification or permission to plant. Missing root ownership prevents execution now, not development or root-free examination.\",\"specification\":\"Submit to the existing current-conversation development handoff; review/development waiting advances no world time. Smallest version: an adapter restricted to actor moss and exact preparedSurfaceId surface-38-moss-234, with modes examine, plant, resume and cancel. Record code reuse of long.prepared-root-placement / prepared-surface-root-placement@1, long.root-planting / root-planting-trial@1 and the source/provenance examination in long.moss-prepared-diagnostic / moss-prepared-surface-diagnostic@1. Do not change the original ability's participant restrictions or broaden ordinary-soil eligibility globally. Proposed personal study costs one completed round and 0.2 energy; registration supplies neither learning nor execution. Examine requires only this adapter's personal learning, valid exact surface identity, visible physical access within 0.65 plus actual body radius, and sufficient energy. A valid examination costs one round and 0.5 energy, consumes no root, takes no material reservation and records a private dated finding with actual checked references and state revision. Invalid identity, scope, reach or insufficient energy costs nothing. Inspect current cover, residue extents, occupancy, people, obstacles, reservations, access and explicitly represented underlying substrate. Preserve the distinction between observed obstruction, unsupported substrate representation, unknown properties and a positively supported placement substrate. Do not infer suitable soil from a non-solid annotation, zero cover or elapsed time. The known separate residue-deposit-49-moss-298 remains 0.04 conserved non-food, nonharvestable matter unless actual subsequent events changed it; do not consume, relocate or convert it during examination or placement. Report specific observed incompatibilities; expose no concealed resources. If the implementation lacks a supported physical substrate case, the executable precursor is this paid compatibility examination with a precise unsupported result; keep the minimal substrate/placement bridge in the same handoff for development, rather than fabricating soil or permanently rejecting the request. Plant requires personally completed adapter learning and root-planting-trial learning (existing duration two rounds, not inherited or granted), exact inputStackId identifying one currently owned unspoiled root unit, and the same live checks. Moss currently owns no root; no input is supplied by this approval, and nearby stock is not inventory or a harvest authorization. Plant's first round costs 0.5 energy for a fresh compatibility examination; it may reserve exactly one root and the radius-0.2 work footprint only if all checks pass. Missing input or invalid invocation fails before payment; a performed valid examination finding physical incompatibility pays for the examination but reserves no root. A prior examine result never replaces this live check. Then require two completed manual work rounds at one energy each, with current reach, occupancy, substrate, reservation integrity and root freshness checked before each charge. No tool, water, soil or other material is created or consumed. Store an exact personal processId, surface ID, input provenance and quantity, escrow location, worksite coordinates, paid-round ledger, remaining work and state revisions. Each paid work round advances one of two units; no unattended work or progress from waiting, review or requests. Repeated starts cannot duplicate a job, root escrow or footprint reservation. Conflicts pause before further charge or progress. Interruption preserves actual escrow, changes and paid progress; resume and cancel require the exact owned processId, and resume pays only remaining work after revalidation. Cancellation or death closes locks and releases surviving unplanted root once on the actual worksite ground, never into remote inventory; preserve actual ageing/spoilage and any physical partial changes. Paid study, examinations and work are not refunded, no spent or spoiled material is restored, and settlement must be idempotent. An interrupted atomic examination records no completed finding; no unperformed step is charged. Incomplete study grants no learned ability or completion evidence; completed paid study effort is not refunded. On successful second work round, atomically transfer the single escrowed root into one persistent root-trial plot linked to surface-38-moss-234 and the original input/provenance, with planted-unverified status. Enforce one-root conservation across inventory, escrow, ground release and plot; no duplicate overlapping placement or root creation. Completed placement cannot be cancelled back into food. Existing environmental ageing and the root-trial observation counter continue; thirty elapsed observation rounds remain inconclusive, not maturity, viability or death. No propagation, harvest, fertility, nutrition, wellbeing, irrigation or maintenance benefit is added. No new maintenance or automatic tending process is introduced. All validations, costs, progress, conservation and settlement rules must execute in code, not repeated model review. Findings remain private unless Moss actually communicates; any other participant must independently act and communicate. No permission, consent, mastery, protected reward account, budget or goal changes.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Evaluate separately from placement success. Study, requests, naming, registration and mastery award no pleasure or satisfaction. This adapter adds no automatic wellbeing effect and no new reward pathway. If existing evidence-deduplicated observation feedback is reused, record that reuse and retain its established coded personal applicability, finite caps, decay and cooldown; do not invent missing values or modify protected accounts. Only a completed examination yielding verified new applicable information, including a specific informative incompatibility, can qualify under that existing rule. Deduplicate by functional evidence and relevant surface-state revision across diagnostic, assessment and placement abilities, not by ability name or repeated paid calls. Familiar actual practice may qualify only under an existing bounded practice rule, not merely because a request succeeded. Without such a configured rule, give factual feedback only. No inferred satisfaction, nutrition or physical comfort from root placement; basic nutrition is unchanged and physical comfort must never exceed 10.\",\"visualReview\":\"Reuse surface-work and plant visual components with event-linked metadata: component, state, label, palette, surface/plot/process references, position, radius, progress and observation tick/revision. Emit examination-completed with compatible, incompatible or unknown finding only after the paid examination actually completes. Examining does not repaint the surface as planted or suitable by assumption. Work-started, work-step-completed, paused and cancelled events reflect real reservations and completed work; render progress as 0/2, 1/2 or 2/2, not elapsed waiting. Preserve the existing partial surface and residue visuals when no physical change occurs. Emit placement-completed and show the covered planted-unverified root-trial visual only after atomic root commitment; partial, blocked, cancelled or failed actions cannot show that success. Keep the separate deposit visible with its actual conserved quantity. Labels must not imply viability, growth, harvestability, comfort or reward. Private findings are not automatically communicated; others can observe only actual visible work and products through their own access.\"}]}"}
